# Branchlock identity concepts — round 2

Generated with the built-in image generation tool. These PNG boards are visual concepts, not production SVG assets. The active app branding has not been changed.

## 01 — Latch

Board: branchlock-latch-v2.png

### Generation prompt

Use case: logo-brand. Create one beautifully art-directed brand identity concept board for Branchlock, a developer application that reviews Git repository workflow security. This is a NEW design, not a screenshot or a code icon. Aim for the level of an independent identity design studio: an original conceptual symbol and carefully drawn wordmark with exceptional optical balance.

Direction 01, LATCH. Invent a single compact, bold symbol in which a Git branch junction is also the shackle of a closed lock. Use clever negative space: two branching routes meet and enclose a secure inner space. The lock and branch must share structural geometry, not be separate icons beside one another. An asymmetric fork gives the symbol distinctive silhouette and controlled tension. Keep it extremely simple, chunky and recognizable at 24px. Avoid generic shield containers.

Wordmark: exact text "Branchlock", capital B only, spelled B-r-a-n-c-h-l-o-c-k. Warm confident custom grotesk lettering, tight and optically kerned, bold broad forms, one subtle angular cut echoing the symbol. White/ivory wordmark, symbol in vivid vermilion-orange #FF7448 against a deep slate #0F172A background. Single flat accent, not a gradient; rich contrast to the app's existing cool blue controls.

Composition: premium landscape concept board, broad negative space, huge main horizontal symbol+wordmark lockup centered in upper two-thirds. Main lockup should occupy 75 percent of width; icon visually balanced with type and ample separation. Along bottom, a thin slate divider and three small well-spaced proof specimens: same symbol alone in orange, same symbol in white monochrome, a compact repetition of the full lockup at header scale. Small discreet corner label "01 / LATCH" only. No other copy or slogans. Everything precisely aligned, generous margins.
Medium: immaculate flat vector-like graphic design, mathematically clean contours, crisp typography, no texture, no glow, no shadows, no 3D, no mockup objects, no stock padlock pasted onto a Git icon, no shield, no circuit-board decoration, no watermark. Output the design board itself.

## 02 — Fork

Board: branchlock-fork-v2.png

### Generation prompt

Use case: logo-brand. Design one exceptional professional identity concept board for Branchlock, a Git workflow security application. A distinctive graphic designer's original visual identity; this should be strong enough to recognize instantly among understated dark-slate application UI.

Direction 02, FORK. Invent a bold angular lowercase b / uppercase B hybrid monogram that also reads as a CLOSED locking mechanism. Its upright spine is a Git trunk and its two carefully engineered arms fork out and reconnect into the locked outer form. One confident diagonal channel of negative space encodes branching. The geometry itself communicates both branching and locking, with no separate pictogram of a padlock added. One solid shape with only one or two generous cutouts, aggressively simple and iconic at 24 px. Slight cut corners, dense compact silhouette; technical yet original. No ornamental container. Let the symbol feel like a mechanical interlock or machined stamp.

Wordmark text exactly "BRANCHLOCK", spelled B-R-A-N-C-H-L-O-C-K. Custom condensed uppercase square grotesk, visible subtly stenciled cuts in two letters echo the monogram, generous enough counters to stay readable; deliberate professional kerning. No italic speed lines. Near-white type and electric acid-lime #D8FF57 symbol on flat deep slate #0F172A. This is an alternative standalone brand palette.

Composition: landscape design board, main large horizontal symbol+wordmark lockup in upper two-thirds with lots of breathing room. Below a very fine slate rule, show the identical symbol alone in accent, a white monochrome symbol, and one smaller header-scale full lockup, evenly spaced. Very small corner label "02 / FORK". No slogans or extra copy. Icon and wordmark visually balanced.
Immaculately crisp flat vector-like graphics, exquisite spacing, simple color, strong silhouette. No 3D, gradients, glow, shadow, ornamental circuit pattern, GitHub cat, shield, ordinary branch glyph paired with ordinary lock, or stock app tile.

## 03 — Loop

Board: branchlock-loop-v2.png

### Generation prompt

Use case: logo-brand. Create an elegant, memorable brand identity concept board for Branchlock, a Git workflow security application, designed with the originality and precision of a specialist identity studio.

Direction 03, LOOP. Design a sculptural but strictly FLAT symbol: one broad continuous ribbon branches at a clean Y junction, loops over, and rejoins into a CLOSED lock silhouette. The branching junction is integral to the lock, not a separate symbol. Use a single broad solid curve with a clear inner counter, one offset terminal node that subtly references Git, and generous negative space. The outer contour should suggest an unexpected rounded lowercase b while still reading as a lock. No extra shield or circle around it. A simple organic-mechanical balance, compelling as a 24 px favicon; maximum two inner voids, no fine line illustration.

Wordmark text exactly "branchlock", all lowercase b-r-a-n-c-h-l-o-c-k. Distinctive custom rounded geometric typography: solid medium-bold weight, open forms, slightly wide stance, flat-cut terminals, balanced letterspacing. Smooth b and o rhythm echoes the symbol, genuinely bespoke rather than an ordinary system font. Wordmark in warm ivory #F6F1E7, symbol in luminous golden apricot #F5BE70, deep slate #0F172A background. Flat colors only.

Presentation: landscape concept board with large horizontal logo lockup occupying the central upper two-thirds, excellent optical alignment and restrained whitespace. Lower specimen strip separated by hairline slate rule: matching icon alone in apricot, matching icon monochrome in ivory, and smaller complete lockup showing header usage. Discreet small corner label "03 / LOOP". No additional text, no tagline.
Render as flawless clean vector-like artwork. No depth, gradients, glow, shadows, texture, perspective, stock shield/padlock imagery, UI cards, or mockup stationery. Emphasis on singular silhouette, typography craft and editorial composition.
